msg: The aim of this game is to get the most mushrooms. There are two forests, a brighter one and a more subdued, darker one. These will have a different amount of mushrooms at any time. You will see gnomes in pairs, orange and brown, green and pink, blue and purple and red and yellow. Brown, pink, yellow and purple take you to the more subdued coloured forest with a yellow basket.Orange, green, red and blue take you to the brighter forest with a red basket.Keep an eye out on which forest seems to have to most mushrooms at any given time and keep trying to go back to it until you notice that has gotten lower and then switch to the other side to see if that has more. If you keep focused enough you should be able to notice which has the most and keep going back to it.
